value.rationale: This is a complete natural symmetry-sector classification of a central half-quorum model rather than a single finite instance: exact periodic orbit counts, primitive periods, full basin cardinalities, a rational zeta function and sharp nonmonotonic dependence on flash duration. It quantitatively separates coasting deadlocks from mutually reinforced locked flashing states and exhibits a narrow all-synchronizing parameter window, a motivated gap in the experimental cluster-locking literature. The equal-group sector is explicitly identified, avoiding extrapolation to unconditioned network ensembles.
